banners.prompt:
Create a square bonus graphic for a sales page, FULL BLEED: the coloured background fills the whole square edge to edge, no white margins, no borders, no frame, no empty white space.
BACKGROUND: dark navy #0F2A4A with a soft warm glow.
LAYOUT: text block in the upper half, left-aligned with about 7% margins, title in white with the second line in yellow-orange; a large, attractive 3D-style visual in the lower half: a tiny black-and-white kitten sitting in a cosy cat bed next to a printed checklist sheet with seven ticked boxes, a small litter box and a food bowl.
TEXT (exactly these lines, nothing else):
1) Small label at the top, yellow-orange pill with navy text: "🎁 БОНУС"
2) Title line 1, very big: "ПЪРВИТЕ 7 ДНИ"
3) Title line 2, very big: "С НОВОТО КОТЕ"
4) Subtitle, medium: "чеклист ден по ден"
Text must be BIG: the title lines take about 30% of the image height in total.

STYLE: premium, warm, friendly, modern; clean professional design like a bestselling publisher would use. Palette from the book cover: dark navy #0F2A4A, warm yellow-orange #F5A623, light sky blue #DCEEFB and white.
TYPOGRAPHY RULES (critical):
- All text is Bulgarian Cyrillic. Render every text line EXACTLY as given, character by character, including punctuation. Do not translate, correct, shorten, re-order or add any words.
- Heavy, clean sans-serif with full Cyrillic (Montserrat ExtraBold / Black style). Large and clearly legible on a phone.
- No other text, logos, watermarks, prices, percentages or website addresses anywhere.
CATS: ordinary domestic cats (tabby, black-and-white, grey, ginger), natural anatomy, correct eyes and paws. NO people, no faces; if a hand appears it is gender-neutral.
